first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention and less damaging to sustainable revenue than broad discounting. Verify the prior onboarding result before acting, then run a guarded test measuring completion, activation, time-to-value, and qualified-revenue quality to ensure faster completion does not reduce downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a standard guarded simplification experiment this week. The verified prior result showed completion up 13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention up 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor activation, qualified pipeline or revenue, retention, and segment effects so improved completion does not mask downstream value loss.
